scope: Exact original R13 executes in ARM WASM through startup, OLED GPIO, USB EP0/HID, RAM CRC, FlexSPI erase/program/IP readback and a model power cycle; two actual Node worker threads execute separate firmware sessions.
limitations: APP1 begins at the captured resident handoff, not a cold ROM or resident-loader execution.
This is a same-image R13 update; a changed firmware identity and broader firmware families are separate evidence.
FCB geometry, busy completion, ADC conversion and bounded companion replies include explicit model fixtures.
NOR policy bounds are enforced by the executed R13 writer; the hardware model permits whole-chip mutations.
No physical USB, PHY, cache coherence, electrical timing, flash endurance or interrupted-update recovery is established.
Stock sampler, SD/filesystem, SAI/DMA audio, complete BMC and all peripheral behavior remain unverified.
Instruction counts and accelerated GPT reads do not establish device deadlines.

systick.timing: modeled source ticks; no physical cycle calibration

flash.sfdpSource: R11 measured bytes with FF fixture padding

limitations: Structural admission does not prove firmware bootability or physical device behavior.
The emulator executes the uploaded startup bytes; it does not substitute reconstructed scatter regions.
APP1 starts at the captured resident handoff, MSP 0x202435B0 and BASEPRI 16. No reset-vector lookup or cold ROM boot occurs.
GPT uses nominal 24 MHz; instruction ticks do not establish Cortex-M7 cycle timing.
GPIO/ADC inputs are injected values; electrical settling, pressure and mechanical calibration are unmodeled.
ADC calibration and conversion complete immediately; failure injection tests bounded firmware paths.
Clock, mux, watchdog and cache registers retain configuration without electrical, expiry or cache-coherency simulation.
UART startup/status/shutdown replies are a bounded companion fixture; complete BMC behavior remains unknown.
SAI models injected FIFO words only; external clocks, audio DMA and physical route identity are unimplemented.
OLED RAM/window/on-off and GPIO SPI are modeled; contrast, scrolling and analog display behavior are unimplemented.
USB device DMA/control tokens are modeled; PHY, cache timing, host mode and isochronous scheduling are unimplemented.
NOR preflight/IP reads/erase/program are modeled; default FCB fields and unread SFDP bytes are fixtures, and unsupported commands report a model error.
ADC_ETC, USDHC/storage, eDMA and other stock peripherals are unimplemented and appear in unknown MMIO.
The default regression clock advances GPT by 24,000 ticks per counter read; this is a fast fixture, not hardware timing.
Integer exceptions are modeled; FPU/lazy frames, fault escalation and complete interrupt timing remain unsupported.
External IRQ count 160 and priority bits 4 are model profile choices; they do not establish the physical configuration.
Instruction counts are emulator work, not measured Cortex-M7 cycles.
